description: Project Title: B1130 Roof ReplacementProject Location: Shaw AFB, SCThis is a presolicitation notice for a construction requirement for the design, demolition, and replacement of the roof for the AFCENT Headquarters building 1130 in accordance with the attached Statement of Workdated 28 February 2026.Period of Performance: 293 Calendar Days after Notice to Proceed issuance.Competition: This requirement is a 100% Small Business Concern Set Aside for North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) code 238160.The Magnitude of this requirement in accordance with Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR) 36.204(F) is valued between $1,000,000.00 and $5,000,000.00.
